scope: External K6 Wormhole portability and matched-operand numerical/workspace study
native_target: Blackhole p150, HiFi4, FP32 weights, row-major BF16 feature tables
adapter: BF16-rounded immutable fixture weights/bias encoded as FP32, tiled-DRAM BF16 input/output, no residual or ReLU, all rows written, bounded output-row chunks; conversions included in forward
first_probe: HiFi3 on small ragged case under Watcher; preserve any compilation/runtime/numerical failure
fidelity_rule: HiFi3 matches fixed fidelity; HiFi4 is an explicitly separate diagnostic, never relabeled as a fixed-track result
limits: no native p150 timing comparison to Wormhole
wide layers may exceed K6 per-core weight budget; reject them rather than silently truncate
